title: Bookworm
html:
Bookworm
Skill Type:  Passive
Trainer:  Mage
Number of Ranks:  1
Cost to Max:  2227
Increase Mana per point of Intellect and adds 5 to Endurance and Intellect. Decreases Health per point of Endurance and reduces Strength and Agility by 5.

Bookworm is a Passive skill that increases Mana gained per point of intellect but decreases Health gained per point of Endurance. The skill is best used by characters that need a significant boost to their Mana pool (most commonly, Mages). Because the skill significantly decreases Health per point of Endurance, Strength, and Agility, it is not the best choice for Fighters or Rangers who use little to no Mana.


This skill currently only has one level, so it can not be upgraded from skill trainers. Below is the description as it appears in the game.


"You have spent most of your life in libraries reading on subjects ranging from thermodynamic entropy to increasing profitability for broccoli farmers below the Tropic of Unicorn - all this knowledge gives you additional Mana points per point of Intellect as well as more Intellect overall. The downside? The lack of exercise has reduced your Health per point of Endurance. Even so, you have managed to read the right diet books and thus have managed to give yourself a slight overall Endurance boost. You spend all day every day reading books and stuff... your atrophying muscles and tendons have reduced your overall Strength and Agility.

  • +100% Mana per Intellect
  • +5 Endurance
  • +5 Intellect
  • -25% Health per Endurance
  • -5 Strength
  • -5 Agility
